issue_request: FHIR-13621 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for RelatedPerson asking that the resource short description change from "An person that is related" to "A person that is related".
initial_application: Git commit 987c2abb05d766abc9b78c0d02cea42fe3e9a468, "Tracker #13146, 13452, 13621", changed the RelatedPerson spreadsheet short description from "An person..." to "A person...". No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-13621 existed on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has active RelatedPerson resource, abbreviation, and approval entries. The current authoritative source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml contains the corrected short description. Remaining old typo occurrences are in archived tools/history release2/release3 snapshots, while release4 and later history snapshots and the active source use the corrected wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build source already satisfies the Jira request. Archived historical release snapshots were not edited because they are not the current authoritative source for this correction.
